definitions.explanation: Putting items on display for public viewing, typically at museums, galleries, trade shows, or similar venues.

examples.japanese: {作品|さくひん}を{展示|てんじ}する。
{美術館|びじゅつかん}で{特別|とくべつ}{展示|てんじ}が{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: A special exhibition is being held at the art museum.

examples.japanese: {新型|しんがた}の{車|くるま}が{展示|てんじ}ホールに{並|なら}んでいて、{多|おお}くの{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}が{足|あし}を{止|と}めていた。
examples.english: New model cars were lined up in the exhibition hall, and many visitors stopped to look.

notes:
STRUCTURE:
{展|てん} (spread, unfold) + {示|じ} (show, indicate).

USAGE:
{展示|てんじ} is used both as a noun and as a する verb ({展示|てんじ}する). It is the standard term for putting things on display at museums, galleries, exhibitions, and trade shows. The related noun {展示会|てんじかい} specifically means an exhibition event or trade fair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {展示|てんじ}する: to exhibit, to display
- {展示|てんじ}{品|ひん}: exhibited item, display item
- {展示|てんじ}ホール: exhibition hall
- {常設|じょうせつ}{展示|てんじ}: permanent exhibition
- {企画|きかく}{展示|てんじ}: special/planned exhibition
